Story of Indra and Virochan
• Experience the Profound Wisdom of the Upanishads!**
Available in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam & Hindi
Select your preferred audio track from the settings menu!
This episode of *Upanishad Ganga* explores the significance of seeking a Guru and the transformative journey of a disciple. The timeless story of Indra and Virochan highlights the difference in perspectives between the Devas and Asuras when approaching knowledge and truth.
